name: הודעת חוב
summary: Explains that unpaid contributions or a benefit recalculation left an outstanding balance, with payment, instalment, or objection steps.

guidance.primaryNextStep: If you can pay in full, do it using the payment details on the notice and keep the receipt.
guidance.deadlineSummary: Pay by the date shown on the notice
guidance.appliesWhen: unpaid national insurance contributions or a recalculation created an outstanding balance
guidance.recommendedChannel: Respond through the branch or payment route printed on the notice and keep the receipt or case reference.
guidance.whenToContactAuthority: you already paid, the debt reason is wrong, or you need an instalment plan before the deadline
guidance.whatToVerify: Verify the charged period, reason for the debt, total amount due, and the last payment date.

sections.explainer: Case number and charge period — identifies the exact insurance account and the months the debt relates to. Use this reference in every phone call or written response.
Reason for the debt — usually unpaid monthly contributions, an employer reporting gap, or a benefit that was later recalculated. This section tells you what triggered the balance.
sections.actionRequired: Compare the stated reason against your own payslips, direct-debit records, or prior benefit letters.

sections.explainer: Amount due — the total outstanding balance, often including linkage and interest. Check whether the figure is one payment or the remaining balance after earlier deductions.
Final payment date — pay by this date to avoid extra interest or collection action. Debt that stays open can affect benefit eligibility and future reimbursements.
sections.actionRequired: If you can pay in full, do it using the payment details on the notice and keep the receipt.
sections.deadline: Pay by the date shown on the notice

sections.explainer: Instalment plan or objection — if the amount is wrong or unaffordable, this section points you to request a payment arrangement or file a challenge with supporting documents.
sections.actionRequired: Ask for instalments immediately if you cannot pay at once; if you dispute the debt, submit the objection in writing with evidence.
sections.deadline: As early as possible, ideally before the payment deadline
